newsitem.title: USA: Horace Mann names Ralph Saul chairman.
newsitem.headline: Horace Mann names Ralph Saul chairman.

text.p: Horace Mann Educators Corp said on Wednesday its board of directors had elected Ralph Saul chairman, succeeding John Gurash, who has retired.
The vote came after shareholders elected five new members to the board at the company's annual meeting and increased the size of the board to nine from seven.
Saul has been a director of the company since June 1995. He served as chairman of the board of Drexel Burnham Lambert during its Chapter 11 reorganization ending in 1992.
New Horace Mann directors include William Abbott, Emita Hill, Jeffrey Morby, Shaun O'Malley and William Schoen. Reelected as directors were Saul, Leonard Green, Paul Kardos and Donald Heth.
Retiring directors included Gurash, Stephen Grady and Charles Williams.
